messages:
Asha: Quick thread to align on minimum GA criteria for Private deployment upgrades. Not trying to rehash other threads; want a concise checklist we can embed in release notes.

Asha: GA must-haves (proposal):
- Installer: idempotent, airgap, clear rollback command.
- Networking: IP whitelist support + documented outbound FQDNs.
- Runtime: KV compatibility shim for rolling upgrades.
- Observability: handshake metrics and installer logs retained for 30d.
- Security: KMS rotation guidance + audit log retention.

Gabe (eng-runtime): I can commit to handshake metrics and a minimal shim. Need agreement on 72h compatibility window.

Rina (eng-infra): We'll provide the installer JSON output for support tokens. Also adding a preflight check with network diagnostics.

Leo (solutions): Field ask: a short one-pager for customers describing 'what changes' per upgrade lane. Also want a test harness we can share with customers for preflight.

Ivy (customer-success): Echo: pilots will not sign until whitelists are clear. If GA misses whitelist docs we risk losing early revenue.

Marta (security): We'll provide a short KMS runbook and audit checklist. Need to confirm retention window (30d ok?). Also request that the release notes explicitly call out any breaking changes.

rollout-bot: Note: canary window scheduled 2026-06-10 01:00 UTC.

Asha: Decision for this thread: GA checklist locked if no objections by Tuesday noon. Also we'll provide a single support contact for pilot handoffs.

Gabe (eng-runtime): +1. I'll open PR for metrics hooks and basic shim today.

Rina (eng-infra): prepping preflight artifacts.

Leo (solutions): drafting the one-pager and customer preflight harness.

Ivy (customer-success): coordinating pilots for checklist sign-off.

Marta (security): scheduling a quick drop-in to review KMS runbook tomorrow.

Asha: Thanks, team. We'll convert this into the 'GA-readiness' card on the roadmap board.
